searchQueries.query: Seeb Oman official cadastral land registry plot map GIS public parcels
searchQueries.result: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning provides national land and real-estate services. Its official geoportal indexes a SeebContract_MIL1 map service with a polygon layer named MUSCAT.Plots. The service root metadata was reachable, but the layer-metadata request returned HTTP 403, preventing safe field/schema review; no feature query was made.
searchQueries.method: Separate language-specific search and official source/service review; no property-specific lookup.
